_readme: The promo card that comes sealed in an Elite Trainer Box, one per SET.
Drives the promo band on /openings/etb.html, built by scripts/build-openings.mjs.
THE UNIT IS THE SET, NOT THE BOX AND EMPHATICALLY NOT THE VIDEO. The owner asked for
this as 'one promo card should be added for every ETB we open, not every ETB
Video but each full set'. A nine pack ETB is ripped across nine videos and the
box still held ONE promo, so a row keyed on the video would multiply one card by
nine. Keying on the box is wrong too, and Chaos Rising is the case that proves
it: the channel has opened THREE Chaos Rising Elite Trainer Boxes across 21
videos, and all three are the same product, so all three held the same Fennekin.
The promo is a property of the PRODUCT, so it is listed once per set however
many boxes of it were opened. The builder enforces that: it keys on set id and
there is no per box or per video field here to get wrong.
READ THIS BEFORE ADDING ANYTHING TO THIS FILE OR MOVING ANYTHING OUT OF IT.
Everything here is a PRODUCT FACT: what The Pokemon Company says is in the box
before anybody opens it. It is not a claim that the owner pulled these cards, and an
ETB promo is not pulled at all, it sits under the sleeves in the tray.
data/hits.json is the other kind of claim, and the two must never be merged.
That file is what came out of a PACK on camera, it is what /hall.html and the
hits page are built from, and its own lede promises 'Nothing here was hand
picked: this is the whole list of what was pulled on camera'. Writing a box
promo into it would break that sentence on the site's most shareable page.
The confusion is easy to make and the data shows why: hits.json already carries
five cards whose rarity is 'Black Star Promo', pulled out of packs, so a promo
in that file is already a meaningful and DIFFERENT thing. None of the five cards
below appears in hits.json today, and if one ever does it belongs in BOTH files
saying two different things, not in one saying a blurred version of each.
EVERY ROW IS FIRST PARTY. `contents` is quoted VERBATIM off the contents list
on The Pokemon Company's own product gallery page for that exact box, and the
url it was read from is in `sources`. Nothing here comes from a retailer
listing, a set tracker or a news site. That matters more than usual on this
file: retailer listings for these boxes routinely paraphrase the promo, several
name the wrong Pokemon, and Target's own page for Pitch Black calls the card
'exclusive' when it ships in the box everywhere.
If pokemon.com has no product gallery page for a set's ETB, the set does NOT go
in this file. A partial sourced list is worth more than a complete guessed one,
and a missing row simply renders no line rather than an empty one.
HAND MAINTAINED, AND DELIBERATELY SO, which is the same call data/upcoming.json
makes for the same reason. There is no API for the contents of a sealed box,
these are five rows that change at most once per set release, and the pages are
client rendered so a sync script would need a browser to read five sentences. A
new set gets a row here by hand when its ETB shows up in videos.json.
THE POKEMON CENTER ETB IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT. Every set below also has a
Pokemon Center exclusive Elite Trainer Box, and it carries its own promo: a
second copy stamped with the Pokemon Center logo, and on some sets a different
card again. shared/taxonomy.mjs has ONE `etb` product tag and cannot tell the
two boxes apart, so listing the Pokemon Center card here would attach it to rips
that may well have been the standard box. `product` names exactly which box each
row was read off, and it is the standard one on all five.
NO COLLECTOR NUMBERS. pokemon.com does not print one, so this file does not
either. A retailer listing quoted 'Tyrunt (MEP070)' and that number is not on
any first party page we can reach, so it is not published here.
set       the set id in shared/taxonomy.mjs, and the join key
promo     the Pokemon the promo card features, as pokemon.com names it
finish    the finish pokemon.com states, so the page never invents one
contents  the contents line, quoted verbatim
product   the exact product the line was read off
sources   where it was read
